_doc: End-to-end benchmark for the library-driven (lib-*) compound primitive tier. Exercises discovery (lib-gsap-spring-stagger is surfaced by recommend_choreography for cinematic-dark dramatic-reveal), routing (motion.compound presence keeps render-routing reactive-aware), and the reactive critic (ANI-146 emits no warnings for matched personality + valid config + boot_ms within duration). The benchmark runner detects motion.compound and compiles with mode='reactive' (ANI-66 + lib-* benchmark follow-up). Reference: project_js_compound_animations.md.
